Package my_package

Class Expression

java.lang.Object
my_package.Expression
Direct Known Subclasses:
Add, Number
public abstract class Expression extends Object
Represents an abstract base class for all mathematical expressions. Provides foundational methods for parsing, evaluation, differentiation, and simplification.

      public int eval(String str)
      Evaluates the expression using a string containing variable assignments. The assignments should be formatted as key-value pairs separated by semicolons (e.g., "x=10; y=13").
      Parameters:
      str - the string containing the variable assignments
      Returns:
      the evaluated integer result of the expression
